Training managers · team leads · in French

Skills and training matrix

Who can do what in your team, against what each job requires: 44 built-in cross-functional skills in 8 areas and 9 job templates with required levels, all editable. Gaps are calculated per person, team and company; critical skills held by fewer than two people are flagged. The training plan links each course to a person and a skill, with dates, costs, statuses and the year's budget planned, committed and spent; a completed course updates the level. Assessment history, printable matrix, CSV export. Minimal personal data, no HR software integration.
